component.subject: Call to Worship
component.source: 1 Corinthians 15:55, 57, Open English Bible, release 2025.6 (US spelling), CC0; verse 57 recast as an imperative, "Give thanks to God".

original.p: 1 Corinthians 15:55 (OEB 2025.6, continuing verse 54): ‘death has been swallowed up in victory! Where, Death, is your victory? Where, death, is your sting?’
1 Corinthians 15:57 (OEB 2025.6): But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory, through Jesus Christ, our Lord.

p.line: Death has been swallowed up in victory!

block.p: Give thanks to God, who gives us the victory, through Jesus Christ, our Lord.
